name: Vantage Quebec City Data Center Campus (QC2)
notes: CDPQ financing release says the Quebec City hyperscale campus was under construction, with a third facility adding 16MW and 86MW total IT capacity once fully developed; Vantage campus page also lists 86MW.

name: Vantage Montreal III (QC6)
notes: Vantage lists Montreal III/QC6 as its third Montreal data center location with 89MW combined IT capacity; DCD reported Vantage completed QC61 in Montreal in early 2026.

name: Bit Digital / Enovum MTL-3 Saint-Jerome
notes: Bit Digital secured an in-development Saint-Jerome, Quebec site leased to Cerebras; 202,000 sq ft facility to support a 5MW colocation agreement, retrofit to Tier III standards, targeted July 2025 go-live.

name: Bit Digital / Enovum MTL-2 Montreal
notes: DCD notes Enovum acquired MTL2 in December 2024; 160,000 sq ft, 5MW, direct-to-chip liquid-cooled site with up to 150kW rack density, set to go live in mid-2025.

name: Enovum MTL-1 Montreal
notes: Existing Montreal facility at 3195 Chemin Bedford launched in 2021; DCD reports 24MW IT capacity across 70,000 sq ft of data center space.

name: Nordik Data Centers NDC1 Shawinigan
notes: Nordik partnered with Accelsius for an AI data center in Quebec; DCD says Nordik's NDC1 in the Shawinigan region offers 5MW IT capacity across 46,000 sq ft.

name: Cologix MTL10 Longueuil
notes: Cologix official MTL10 page lists a Montreal/Longueuil data center with 180,000 sq ft and 35MW; DCD also reports MTL10 at 530 Rue Beriault, Longueuil.

name: eStruxture MTL-2 Montreal
notes: eStruxture official MTL-2 page lists total capacity of 30MW at 7001 Rue Saint-Jacques, Montreal; RENX reported the conversion of the former printing facility into the 30MW data centre.

name: OVHcloud BHS Campus Beauharnois
notes: Beauharnois, Quebec campus is repeatedly identified as a major OVHcloud data center; Data Center Knowledge reported 120MW hydropower support and OVHcloud says BHS opened in 2012 and hosts nearly 90,000 servers.

name: Microsoft Azure Canada East Region
notes: Microsoft Learn lists Azure Canada East with physical location in Quebec and programmatic name canadaeast; exact facility/capacity not disclosed.

name: Equinix Montreal IBX Data Centers
notes: Equinix official Canada/Montreal pages identify Montreal IBX colocation facilities; capacity not disclosed in public page.

name: Bell AI Fabric Data Centre Project, RM of Sherwood
notes: Bell and Saskatchewan announced a 300MW data centre just outside Regina; later Bell named early-stage contractors. IAAC registry describes the proposed 300MW industrial AI data centre on a 65-hectare agricultural site.

name: Carpere Valley / AI Health Town Data Center, Moose Jaw
developer: Carpere Valley Development Corporation / Aztec AI Health
notes: DCD reported a proposed 150MW AI data center as part of a 150-acre, $485M redevelopment of the former Valley View Centre near Moose Jaw; Baxtel lists it as planned with 2028 target.

name: Prairie2Cloud Sovereign AI Compute Campus
notes: Prairie2Cloud states it is developing a 300MW+ sovereign AI compute campus in Saskatchewan; third-party summaries place concept near Belle Plaine with phased 10MW initial load. Treat as early-stage/prospective.

name: SaskTel Saskatoon North Data Centre
notes: SaskTel opened a 24,000 sq ft Tier III certified facility in Saskatoon with 9,650 sq ft of data hall space, expandable to 30,000 sq ft; SaskTel official colocation page lists Saskatoon North among four Saskatchewan colocation facilities.

name: SaskTel White City Data Centre
notes: SaskTel official colocation page lists White City as one of four Saskatchewan colocation data centre facilities; DataCenterMap describes White City as a Tier III colocation facility near Regina.

name: Whitehorse Data Centre Upgrades
notes: Yukon five-year capital plan lists Whitehorse data centre upgrades under building maintenance/recapitalization with funding ranges through 2023-24. Separate 2014 Yukon-commissioned market analysis evaluated feasibility for attracting/building a larger data centre, but no public hyperscale or colocation project was found.
